title: Say Managpaalagey na Saray Babel
intro: Diad malaknab iran bansa, sakey a makapanyarin indibidual so linma ed nantutumbokan iran ekspedisyon, ya inikdan na baleg ya autoridad tan pakayari. Sayan kamarerwa so akaabet na nanduruman komunidad tan akaarap ed nikadkaduman angat, ya angitilak na magnayon a marka ed awaran tan pananisia diad panamegley na saray kiwas tan kakabatan da, legan dan bibidbiren so peteg a lapuan na biskeg da.
clues: Naikdan ak na pakayari tan pakayari ed amin a bengatla, tan tinumbok ko so sakey a paraan.
Say biahek so angitonton ed siak ed pasen a panselek na banwa, a ditan et akaromog ak na totoo.
Walay akabat kon komunidad ya ngalngali agmakatalos na panagsalita, ya manaayam ed baetan na duaran palandey.
Siak so kinerew a manggawa na babeng, aliwan parad personal a pankaabigan, noagta pian protektaan sumpad makaderal a puersa.
Inkuan ko ya say biskeg ya mangipaalagey ed sayan baleg a padir et nanlapud si Allah, tan mansiansia itan anggad insipan a panaon.
Say ngaran ko, ya mabetbet ya ipapatalos ya 'Say Duaran-Saklor,' et mankabaliksan na pakasabik ed interon mundo odino nayarin duaran nanduruman panaon.
arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
verse: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam. (18:95)
